scenes.title: Fake Identities and Stolen Millions
scenes.summary: Detectives inform a furious Muranishi that his vanished accountant used a fake name and address, while on the highway his former assistant laughs that stealing the cash was exactly what Muranishi would do.
scenes.location: looted studio office and coastal highway

scenes.title: Turned Away and Accused of Fraud
scenes.summary: Rejected coldly when he begs the conglomerate Proprietor for a loan, Muranishi orders his villa sold and blurs thinned, while a furious actress confronts the junior director over her missing thirty million yen.
scenes.location: conglomerate mansion and studio editing room

scenes.title: Thirty Billion Lost in Two Minutes
scenes.summary: Muranishi begs the satellite company President not to cut his contract, only to learn that a failed rocket launch wiped out thirty billion yen in two minutes and the President himself is resigning.

scenes.title: When He Stopped Feeling Like the Emperor
scenes.summary: As unpaid actresses go on strike and search the studio for cash, Kuroki quietly observes that everything fell apart the moment Muranishi stopped believing he was the emperor of adult video.
scenes.location: apartment dining table and studio office

scenes.title: I Am Not an Object
scenes.summary: Exhausted and bitter after failing to raise funds, Muranishi grabs his new star roughly; she pushes him away, demanding respect and reminding him not to tear himself down.

scenes.title: Cashing In on Master Tapes
scenes.summary: Kawada unlocks his prized master tapes and teams up with Toshi to dub half-price legitimate reissues for seed money, while Muranishi heads out on the final day of his satellite payment deadline.

scenes.title: A Deadly Loan from Furuya
scenes.summary: At a diner, Detective Takei needles Muranishi about Kawada and Toshi working together and steers him toward Furuya, who lends Muranishi 250 million yen on pain of death for his entire family.
scenes.location: coffee shop and Furuya syndicate office

scenes.title: Seven Hundred Sixty-Three Subscribers
scenes.summary: Muranishi brings 250 million yen to the bank Section Chief, who lays out devastating subscriber figures and four billion yen in debt—yet Muranishi still orders the cash wired to the satellite.

scenes.title: Warm Helpers vs Angry Creditors
scenes.summary: Toshi brings neighborhood part-timers to speed up Kawada's tape packaging—setting Kuroki's debut tape aside untouched—while unpaid vendors storm Muranishi's studio demanding millions.

scenes.title: The Forbidden Fruit Trap
scenes.summary: Detective Takei and Furuya gloat over Muranishi taking both the 250-million-yen loan and an illegal uncensored master tape, as Muranishi calls his staff promising a celebration.

scenes.title: Actresses Are Merchandise
scenes.summary: Muranishi's celebration toast implodes when his horrified junior director reveals Muranishi sold bootleg uncensored videos of their own actresses, and Muranishi shouts that they are merchandise he owns.

scenes.title: Abandoned by Everyone
scenes.summary: Declaring uncensored video his true mission, Muranishi demands his cast shoot an uncensored scene on the spot and screams at every shocked actress and crew member to get out until the room stands empty.

scenes.title: Reunion at Kawada's Studio
scenes.summary: With their reissue sales thriving, Kawada and Toshi are ready to shoot original works again—and welcome their former female colleague aboard as their new director.

scenes.title: Quitting Today and Thirty Million Yen
scenes.summary: Heartbroken by Muranishi's betrayal, the loyal junior director finally quits the company and offers his own thirty million yen in hard-earned savings to comfort the betrayed actress.

scenes.title: Kuroki's Proposal and the Whistle Tape
scenes.summary: After the satellite channel goes off the air, Kuroki visits Muranishi with a startling proposal—asking him to kill her—and Muranishi watches the tape of their very first whistle shoot.
